subject: Meridian solution rollout — roles, training windows, and action items
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Meridian solution rollout — initial plan and roles

Camila / Irene,

Quick note to start the thread for the Meridian Consulting engagement. They’re targeting a Q3 joint delivery for a consultative SI-led embed of Redwood for their client pilots. High-level asks from the pre-call: enablement for 6 SIs, 2-day train-the-trainer, integration checklist for Private deployment, and a joint go-live runbook.

I attached a rough outline (Meridian-enablement-outline.pdf) — I want us to align on owners and dates before looping Meridian in. Proposed internal owners:
- Camila: technical onboarding & sandbox provisioning
- Irene: enablement content and certification checklist
- Sean: project cadence, SLAs, and commercial handoff

Immediate questions:
1) Can Camila confirm which sandbox topology (VPC peering vs. dedicated staging) we should provision for their SI labs?
2) Irene — do we have a condensed 2-day slide/booklet that maps to our certification exercises?

I’ll draft a mutual action plan once we confirm.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Meridian-enablement-outline.pdf
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian solution rollout — initial plan and roles

Thanks Sean — copying my notes from the scoping call with Meridian (Alex / Priya) last week. I’ll also drop their SOW when they send it.

Quick answers:
- Sandbox topology: recommend dedicated staging projects with VPC peering into their dev account. That minimizes noise during the SI lab days and lets us snapshot images. We’ll need Meridian’s CIDR blocks and a service account for provisioning.
- 2-day curriculum: we have a condensed deck (I’ll attach the training deck) that maps to hands-on labs (embed flow, model pinning, traffic routing, rollback). It’s about 12 modules — we can trim to 6 for the train-the-trainer.

I’m happy to own the lab environment work and test a host-run on May 18–19 if that works for Sean’s proposed timeline.

Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

> Quick answers:
> - Sandbox topology: recommend dedicated staging projects with VPC peering into their dev account. That minimizes noise during the SI lab days and lets us snapshot images. We’ll need Meridian’s CIDR blocks and a service account for provisioning.
> - 2-day curriculum: we have a condensed deck (I’ll attach the training deck) that maps to hands-on labs (embed flow, model pinning, traffic routing, rollback). It’s about 12 modules — we can trim to 6 for the train-the-trainer.

Thanks Camila — this aligns with our internal ask. Priya and I reviewed the outline and we can confirm the following:
- Target train-the-trainer window: June 8–9 (US Pacific; remote).
- Pilot cohort: 6 SI engineers + 2 PMs.
- Meridian will provide CIDR and a service account by 2026-05-10.
- We will send SOW version 1 by end of day today (attaching).

Couple of asks for Redwood to confirm before the June dates:
1) A short runbook on expected latency and model sizing recommendations for their early workloads.
2) SOC2 evidence list and contact for security questionnaire.
3) A DocuSign link for the SOW so we can lock dates.

Look forward to the mutual plan.

— Alex Pearson
Director, Alliances | Meridian Consulting
alex.pearson@meridian-consulting.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Pearson <alex.pearson@meridian-consulting.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Das <priya.das@meridian-consulting.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian solution rollout — initial plan and roles

Alex / Priya — thanks, and welcome. We’re excited to run this with Meridian. Below is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) we can paste into the HubSpot deal and use for the DocuSign SOW: feel free to suggest edits.

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- By 2026-05-10: Meridian provides CIDR blocks, service account email, and primary POC for infra. (Owner: Meridian)
- By 2026-05-12: Redwood provides SOC2 evidence checklist, security contact, and initial latency/model sizing doc. (Owner: Irene / Sean)
- By 2026-05-18: Redwood provisions dedicated staging environment and shares access instructions for SI labs. (Owner: Camila)
- 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-09: Train-the-trainer (remote). Redwood leads lab delivery; Meridian provides cohort list. (Owner: Camila / Meridian)
- 2026-06-22: Canary pilot with 2 client projects; rollback & fallback policy test. (Owner: Camila / Meridian)

Technical notes / prerequisites
- Staging topology: dedicated project with VPC peering; we’ll need a service account with compute and network privileges to create peering and snapshots.
- KMS / keys: if Meridian prefers customer-managed keys, please indicate KMS provider and key ARN by 2026-05-12.
- Metrics & tracing: we’ll expose per-route latency and token-cost dashboards; add an env tag \"meridian-pilot\" for filtering.

Attachments and links
- Training deck (condensed): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3MeridianEnablement (Camila uploaded)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/MER-2026-0512
- DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.com/templates/abc123

Next operational steps (this week)
1) Alex: confirm service account email & CIDR by Monday 2026-05-10.
2) Irene: send SOC2 checklist & security contact (Irene, can you take point?).
3) Camila: schedule staging provisioning for 2026-05-14 and preliminary run of lab scripts on 2026-05-18.

Irene and Camila — if you’re OK with the MAP I’ll paste it into the HubSpot deal and trigger the DocuSign template so Meridian can sign and lock dates.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
